drought.geography: 91 OCHA COD-AB v03 district features; unknown strict-QA targets excluded
drought.label_source: MOD13Q1 V061 strict-QA NDVI standardized against the fixed 2015-2020 district/seasonal-slot reference climatology
drought.positive_definition: future composite reference-period NDVI anomaly z-score <= -1.0
drought.negative_definition: future composite reference-period NDVI anomaly z-score > -1.0
drought.unknown_definition: future composite absent or strict-QA NDVI is null
drought.minimum_history: one prior available composite and 90 days of climate history
leakage_controls: future vegetation is label only; reference climatology is fitted only from the outer training era
last vegetation feature composite must have ended on or before feature_as_of_date
all rainfall and POWER windows end on feature_as_of_date
drought.interpretation: agricultural drought condition; not humanitarian impact

flood.geography: SH001, SH002, SH004, JB001, JB009 only
flood.label_source: observed future gauge level and current official moderate threshold
flood.positive_definition: maximum observed level on days t+1 through t+3 >= station moderate threshold
flood.negative_definition: all three future daily levels observed and below threshold
flood.unknown_definition: one or more required future days missing
flood.minimum_history: seven prior daily gauge observations plus 30 days of climate history
leakage_controls: all feature windows end at t
flood.interpretation: riverine risk at five supported Jubba/Shabelle gauges; not Somalia-wide flash flood risk

food_security.unit_of_prediction: canonical OCHA region matched to IPC Level 1
food_security.geography: 18 canonical regions; historical IPC aliases resolved by the Phase 01 crosswalk
food_security.prediction_horizon: 30 days before the observed current IPC validity period starts
food_security.label_source: IPC Level 1 current assessment Phase 3+ population percentage
food_security.unknown_definition: missing current Phase 3+ row or unresolved region
food_security.minimum_history: 90 days of environmental data before as-of date
leakage_controls: target assessment fields are never predictors
previous IPC is allowed only when its validity end is on or before feature_as_of_date
MODIS composites must have ended before feature_as_of_date
market and climate windows end before feature_as_of_date
food_security.interpretation: regional high Crisis-or-Worse burden; not a district IPC classification
